finance-description: For every action, the tool compares what the action needs (capital and preparation) against what {{city}} has (budget autonomy and delivery capacity) to estimate how realistically the city can finance and deliver it — and which funds could help close the gap.
no-finance-description: No climate-finance feasibility data was found for this city yet. You can still continue to the next step — the ranking will be generated without financial feasibility.
profile-self-sufficient-desc: {{city}} sits in the higher band for both financial autonomy and delivery capacity.
profile-delivery-ready-desc: {{city}} sits in the higher band for delivery capacity and the lower band for financial autonomy.
profile-well-resourced-desc: {{city}} sits in the higher band for financial autonomy and the lower band for delivery capacity.
profile-support-ready-desc: {{city}} sits in the lower band for both financial autonomy and delivery capacity.
profile-unknown-desc: The finance data has no profile for {{city}}.
route-self-tagline: Low-capital action the city can deliver itself.
route-own-budget-tagline: Within the city's own budget and capacity.
route-technical-assistance-tagline: Capacity is the constraint, not money.
route-cofinance-tagline: Capital need exceeds the city's autonomy — outside funds can cover the gap.
route-support-tagline: High capital and preparation needs — external finance plus technical support or pooling.
route-unknown-tagline: The finance data has no route for this action.
table-title: What's financially aligned — and what isn't
table-description: Filter by financing route to see what's feasible now versus what needs outside support. Expand a row for the full reasoning, matched funds and funded projects per action.
no-route-matches: No actions match the selected route.
self-fundable-note: This action is feasible from the city's own budget — external funding is not required. Any sector funds below are optional sources the city could choose to use.
no-opportunities-body: No catalogued funds currently match this action. This will update automatically as new funding rounds are added.
no-projects-body: No catalogued projects in the national investment records currently match this action. This will update automatically as new delivery rounds are added.
projects-page-note: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} matched projects.
finance-error-body: The climate-finance service didn't respond. Your other inputs are unaffected — try again, or continue and generate the ranking without financial feasibility.
score-tip: How realistically the city can finance and deliver this action, from 0 to 1.
fund-access-tip: Catalogued funds this action can reach, and whether the city applies directly or competes for them. Self-fundable actions need none.
finance-load-error-body: Something went wrong while fetching this data. Try again in a moment.
